results.content: **Section 002 (Sheridan)*****The Production of Culture***This class focuses on the ways that the analytical and creative work of the arts and humanities can help to solve real-world problems. *Learning Languages through Community Arts***In this introductory course on language and culture, we will explore the intricate connection between language and identity formation, as well as our interactions with the world around us. Four faculty will explore this question by looking at how the theme of storytelling connects the four RCAH pathways—the Arts, the Humanities, Community Engagement, and Language and Culture. In this course we will explore the wealth of music and dance traditions in America engaging topics such as: the role of performance in American cultural life; the relationship between art and commerce; American musical nationalism, performance spaces as a contact zone and birthplace for new styles; and American ambivalence about artistic practice.
